data.question: Persentase penduduk miskin di Maluku Utara saat ini?

value.raw_question: Persentase penduduk miskin di Maluku Utara saat ini?

value.sql:
SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah, 
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS total_nilai,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nilai_indikator.nilai < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jumlah_miskin
FROM 
    provinsi
INNER JOIN 
    nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama
ORDER BY 
    total_nilai DESC, 
    jumlah_miskin DESC
LIMIT 1;

value.sql:
SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100 / SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) OVER() AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.kode, provinsi.nama
ORDER BY persentase_penduduk_miskin DESC;

SELECT T1.wilayah AS wilayah, T1.periode AS periode, AVG(T2.nilai) AS nilai_percentage
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator AND T2.periode = :periode AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.wilayah, T1.periode;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.nilai AS nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    nilai_indikator.periode AS periode,
    (SELECT SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) / SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100
     FROM nilai_indikator
     WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
       AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
       AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)) AS nilai_penduduk_miskin
FROM
    provinsi
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY
    nilai_penduduk_miskin DESC;

SELECT
  provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
  periode,
  AVG(nilai) AS nilai
FROM
  nilai_indikator
JOIN
  provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
  nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
  provinsi.nama,
  periode
ORDER BY
  nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai,
    COUNT(nilai_indikator.kode_indikator) * 100 / (
        SELECT COUNT(nilai_indikator.kode_indikator) FROM nilai_indikator
        WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
        AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
        AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
    ) AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM
    nilai_indikator
JOIN
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    provinsi.nama
ORDER BY
    nilai DESC;

SELECT T1.wilayah, T1.periode, SUM(T2.nilai) / COUNT(*) AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND T2.periode = :periode
AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.wilayah, T1.periode;
